review: independent bounded exact-artifact delivery and typed proper migration review
contract_findings: Version-1 delivery validation retains legacy public archives with nonempty HTTPS routes and permits only the explicit offline-only variant with an empty URL array. Offline records cannot advertise a route or silently fetch.

Scoped preservation requires append, offline-only and an explicit safe source-evidence selection together; it resolves selected new payloads, preserves old archive/entry arrays and snapshot, and performs no upload.

Archive members are verified before the appended sidecar is atomically replaced. Invalid selection, changed or missing selected source, manifest mismatch and size-bound failures preserve prior index declarations; hydration verifies each exact member before atomic cache installation.

Tar metadata and member order are deterministic. Existing selected declarations remain unchanged on repeated append. Legacy public packing, fetching, strict validation and unsafe-member refusals retain their focused regression coverage.

The new proper-1962 manifest accurately declares the existing three authored schema-2 outputs, semantic source roles and unchanged component contracts. It adds typed discovery without editing accepted prose, generation provenance or native audit records.

independent_checks.result: The actual four-member tar was compared with all four committed source payloads and manifest hashes. An isolated scoped append reproduced its bytes and the complete current index exactly; repeating it left every pack file byte-identical.

With network access replaced by a refusal, uncached offline fetch fails clearly, metadata validation succeeds, and explicit local-archive hydration restores all four exact payloads only in the isolated cache.

All 97 prior canonical leaf files and all 58 native v15 archive files match the source commit byte for byte. Four source artifact manifests match that commit; the four canonical binary paths are absent from the worktree and fully covered by the verified delivery members.
All eight logs bound by artifact-preservation.json match their declared hashes, including the eight successful registered example replays.

limits: The offline pack and cache are local ignored artifacts. No new public route, continuing remote availability or external upload is asserted; the original payloads also remain in existing Git history.
Legacy archive declarations were preserved and regression tested; their remote payloads were not downloaded again.
This structural/storage migration preserves accepted v15 evidence and provenance. It is not a v16 workflow rerun, renewed scholarly review or new print approval.
This verdict is bounded to the frozen listed files and four-payload migration. Final source currentness, shared projections, site integration and disclosure receive the later frozen-snapshot review.
No shared source, index, release, native archive or delivery pack was mutated by this reviewer; all packing and hydration writes were isolated scratch fixtures.
